prompt:
The snippet snippets/newsletter-consent.liquid currently fails to parse and has logic gaps. Rewrite it so it renders a customer's newsletter consent summary exactly as specified. Inputs. All are top-level variables and every one is always supplied: - email: string or null. - consent_status: string or null. - lists: array of strings, or null. It may be an empty array. Rules: 1. Let ADDR be email with leading and trailing whitespace stripped. A null email counts as an empty string. If ADDR is empty, output nothing at all, not even whitespace. 2. Let STATUS be consent_status stripped of surrounding whitespace and lowercased. A null value counts as an empty string. If STATUS is not exactly "granted", "pending" or "revoked", treat it as "unknown". 3. Otherwise output, in this order: -
-

ADDR

, where ADDR is HTML-escaped. - A message paragraph

TEXT

. TEXT depends on STATUS: - granted: Subscribed - pending: Awaiting confirmation - revoked: Unsubscribed - unknown: No consent recorded - When STATUS is granted only, a list
    follows the message paragraph. It holds one
  • NAME
    • per entry of lists, in input order. NAME is the entry stripped of surrounding whitespace and HTML-escaped. Entries that are empty after stripping are skipped. If no entries remain, or if lists is null or empty, omit the
      element entirely. -
4. The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags and no leading or trailing whitespace. Example for a granted status:

a@b.co

Subscribed

  • Weekly
Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/newsletter-consent.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
